title: Stale or unsighted automated-test record and complexity runs
cluster_summary: Every addon's newest docs/automated-tests bundle predates kit rev 35 (no blindFiles) and is 47 to 173 commits behind HEAD. automated-tests.md:295 says going stale between releases is expected, and §6 makes the release run the checkpoint that refreshes the record. This exercise cuts no release, so re-running bundles now is churn that goes stale on the next commit. The stale /wow-addon:bump-version header text also needs no fix, because the current runner already prints /dev-copilot:bump-version. No upstream fix is needed. Two items carry real future release-gate blockers: AuraMaster logCandidates at CCN 18 (a cheap and/or-defaulting fold, worth doing now with a characterization test first) and LootHistory's 26 functions above CCN 15 plus the BrowserTable.lua peel (make it visible now with a release-blocker issue, and refactor the worst real-control-flow cases if capacity allows). Everything else is no.

verdicts.assessment: The bundle is 57 commits behind and unsighted, but automated-tests-§4 (line 295) and §6 expect staleness between releases. Max CCN is 14 and no threshold is crossed.

Verified: logCandidates (modules/Anchors_Snap.lua:891-911) is CCN 18 from and/or defaulting, and the automated-tests-§3 release gate would block on it. It does not gate commits. Part (b), the sighted bundle plus band dispositions, is a release-time duty under §6, not a current one.
verdicts.remediation: Add a characterization test of the [Anchor] debug line first, then fold the and/or defaults into named locals or a module-level helper (e.g. targetRectText(dragged, t)) until the complexity suite shows max CCN <= 15. Leave RESULTS.md and the bundle alone. The sighted bundle and the Anchors_Snap.lua / test_anchors_drag.lua dispositions wait for the next release run.

verdicts.assessment: 67 commits stale, which is expected between releases (§4/§6). The CCN-16 function is tracked separately as F-001, and the header text is fixed in the current runner.
Duplicate of BL-A-07. The live problems it mentions (F-001, Browser.lua size) are tracked under their own findings, and the record is regenerated at release.
Today's sighted run is clean (0 warnings, max CCN 15). The band dispositions and the header refresh happen at the next release run by rule.
81 commits stale, but today's sighted run passes with 0 warnings and max CCN 15. The release is the checkpoint.

The stale record and the cosmetic preamble edit (e09cf58, rename only) need nothing. The substance is 26 functions above CCN 15 (max 24) and BrowserTable.lua at 1476 lines: a real next-tag blocker under the automated-tests-§3 release gate, though it gates no commit and has no player impact.
verdicts.remediation: Do not re-run or edit the record now. File one LootHistory release-blocker issue listing the 26 CCN>15 functions and the BrowserTable.lua peel. If capacity allows, refactor the real-control-flow worst cases (convertHolderMoves 24, Database.Stats 23, onEvent 21) with a characterization test first. Guard-run functions (NS.StandUp, StandDown) can take a written ruling at release. Band dispositions belong to the release run.
